name: live station directory
sql: SELECT CAST(count(*)>100 AS INTEGER) FROM buoys.main.stations

name: live latest observations
sql: SELECT CAST(count(*)>100 AND count(time)=count(*) AS INTEGER) FROM buoys.main.latest_observations()

name: live Boston station history
sql: SELECT CAST(count(*)>100 AND count(time)=count(*) AND count(wave_height_m)>0 AS INTEGER) FROM buoys.main.observations('44013')
